    sols = list(base.Solids())
    print(f"INFO: total solids in STEP = {len(sols)}")

    idx_s17 = None
    for i, s in enumerate(sols):
        for ff in s.Faces():
            if ff.wrapped.IsSame(f361.wrapped):
                idx_s17 = i
                break
        if idx_s17 is not None:

    print("SELECTED:", 1 if idx_s17 is not None else 0, "solid for s17 stand (via face #361)", "idx=", idx_s17)

        print("ERROR: could not locate the solid containing face #361; returning input unchanged")

    print("INFO: original stand bbox:",

    print("ADDED: bbox ymin/ymax=", float(bb_added.ymin), float(bb_added.ymax), " zmin=", float(bb_added.zmin))

    target_common_mirror_ctrs = [(-18.628, 11.43, -121.114), (18.628, 11.43, -121.114)]

        "TARGETS: housing vol=%.3f bbox%s..%s; remove body with common(housing)=%.3f at %s; retain two bodies with common=%.3f at %s and %s"
        % (
            target_housing_vol,

            abs(bb.xmin - mn[0]) <= tol
            and abs(bb.ymin - mn[1]) <= tol
            and abs(bb.zmin - mn[2]) <= tol
            and abs(bb.xmax - mx[0]) <= tol

            cc = c.Center()
            ctr = (cc.x, cc.y, cc.z)
